description: The crypto market from CoinGecko: coins ranked by market value with price, volume, change over a day, a week and a month, supply and distance from the all-time high, and the whole market's value with bitcoin's and ether's shares; or the coins named, by symbol or CoinGecko id.

coins.description: Coins by symbol (btc, eth) or CoinGecko id (bitcoin, ethereum); default the largest by market value.

limit.description: How many of the largest; default 25.

name: crypto_markets

outputSchema.description: rows are coins by market value in the order of columns; market is the whole market's value and shares.

title: Crypto markets (CoinGecko)
